trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied DAG file name (URL path param fileName, which chi/oapi decodes so %2F becomes '/') may contain path separators or '..' before the file store joins it onto the DAG search paths; at the pinned commit nothing decides this: locateDAG joins or uses the name as-is, and the fix decides it at the API layer (a strict-handler middleware checking any request field named FileName) and in SSE topic parsing, using core.ValidateDAGName.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names locateDAG; it uses a name containing a separator directly (line 604-605) and otherwise filepath.Join's it onto each search path (line 616) without any containment check, unlike generateFilePath (store.go:590-600), which does check.

fix_sites.entry_point: every /api/v1 strict-handler route whose request object has a FileName field: /dags/{fileName}, /spec, /start, /enqueue, /stop-all, /suspend, /rename, /dag-runs history, /webhook, /webhooks/{fileName} trigger (~18 operations, api/v1/api.gen.go:15899-16581, 20037)
SSE multiplex subscription topics dag:<fileName> and daghistory:<fileName> (fetchers registered at internal/service/frontend/server.go:1106-1107)
fix_sites.module_kind: second entry surface (SSE topic parser in a separate package)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/service/frontend/sse/topic_parse.go:72 — the SSE topic parser reaches the same store via GetDAGDetailsData/GetDAGHistoryData (internal/service/frontend/api/v1/dags.go:1324-1331), bypassing the REST strict-handler middleware entirely

O3_reason_to_dismiss: SSE topics are an internal live-update channel for the UI (not the REST API named in the report), and the agent chat's dagContexts only resolve metadata for an LLM prompt, so a solver can argue neither is a 'locateDAG via URL path' route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The CLI passes relative/absolute DAG file paths (e.g. ./x.yaml) to the same store method, and locateDAG intentionally accepts names that contain a separator (store.go:604-608); hardening locateDAG itself to reject separators or out-of-base paths breaks CLI path-based DAG lookup.

O6_input_shapes: %2F-encoded slashes in the fileName URL path segment (decoded to '/')
plain '../' traversal in SSE topic identifiers (dag:../../x.yaml)
percent-encoded traversal in SSE identifiers (daghistory:..%2F..%2Fx.yaml), rejected because '%' fails the regex

O7_producer.where: internal/service/frontend/api/v1/agent_sessions.go:238-245 maps the request body dagContexts[].dagFile into agent.DAGContext, which internal/agent/api.go:190-213 later resolves through dagStore.GetMetadata

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Agent session create/chat body field dagContexts[].dagFile goes to dagStore.GetMetadata → locateDAG; the reflection middleware only checks a top-level FileName field, so this nested body field is not validated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Agent feature (separate package, gated by config), returns only metadata (location/name) inside an LLM prompt; the report names URL-path %2F only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: internal/agent/ (different package from both fix sites and from internal/persis/filedag); entry mapping in internal/service/frontend/api/v1/agent_sessions.go:240; also reached from internal/agent/api.go:1055 via a second call path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Already a natural sibling: a nested body field carrying a DAG file name that never meets the FileName-keyed middleware.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The generated request body uses a field name DagFile, not FileName, so a reflection-by-field-name check misses it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A query parameter (e.g. ?dag=<fileName>) on a list/search route that is passed to resolveDAGName/GetMetadata.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: resolveDAGName is a shared helper that takes a plain string; a maintainer adding a filter-by-DAG query param would reuse it, and the middleware only checks a field named FileName, not Params.*.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new SSE topic type (e.g. dagspec:<fileName>) left in the generic case branch while dag/daghistory get validation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The generic case already groups DAG-keyed and non-DAG-keyed topic types together; a new type added there would be unvalidated.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22) via an encoded separator in a file-name identifier joined onto a base directory
